授業概要
分子生物学、 遺伝学、系統・分類学、生物地理学、生態学、進化生物学、古生物学、土壌環境微生物学等の生物学諸分野および、環境地理学や環境政策学、資源管理学等の分野に関する幅広い知識と、各分野に関わる解析・調査の高度な技術を身につけることにより、生物多様性をふまえた人類存立問題の解決に貢献する能力を習得する。
Students will learn how to contribute to solutions of the basic problems of humankind which are closely related to biodiversity issues, by acquiring extensive knowledge and sophisticated skills to conduct various analyses and surveys in such fields as molecular biology, genetics, phylogenetics, taxonomy, Soil environmental microbiology, biogeography, ecology, evolutionary biology, paleontology as well as environmental geography, environmental politics and resource management sciences.

生物多様性をふまえた人類存立問題の解明と対処方法の探求のために、総合的な課題発見・分析・解決能力を備えた高度専門職業人の育成を目指す。
In order to elucidate the problems concerning the basisof human existencewhich are closely connected to biodiversity issues, and to pursue how to cope with them, we aim to develop highly professionals who have comprehensiveability to identify, analyze and solve theproblems.
